name: MemTrial
learner: auto (prequential choice between the per-experience and the content-based value model)
gate: prequential forward-validation test, one-sided t-test of per-date Pearson r between predicted and realised contributions, alpha 0.05, at least 10 scored dates
open_action: designed subset with the highest predicted value (ties -> fewer experiences); only if predicted gain > 0
closed_action: KL-anchored FTRL between the conservative reference and the average of the designed drafts; prior 0.9 on the reference, lambda0 4
content_features: 8-dim PCA of the retrieval embedding of each experience (standardised); identity model = Fay-Herriot without features

selection.rule: lowest mean regret over 3 investors x 7 regimes on controlled dev seeds 0-14 among alpha-0.05 variants
selection.note: alpha kept at 0.05 as frozen before the monthly PortBench run; alpha 0.2 (0.0330) goes to the sensitivity analysis

note: frozen_code_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the method file as frozen (first commit of this repository); afterwards only its names and terms were updated to those of the paper (MemTrial, conservative reference), which gives code_sha256
